_comment: The condition kinds a kit declaration's `showWhen` may use. Read by kitShown.js (the editor) and by scripts/lib/kit-show-when.mjs (the generators' validation). `needs` lists the extra keys a leaf of that op carries; `extensionAttributes` are attributes a block gets from a support, not from its block.json (scripts/generate-extension-attributes.js SUPPORT_DRIVEN), so a condition may read them.
